name: HDDA Skip
definition: A ray traversal algorithm that uses Hierarchical DDA (HDDA) to skip empty regions of a VDB occupancy grid, advancing the ray time (t) in bulk steps rather than sampling every voxel.
summary: HDDA Skip is a ray traversal algorithm for sparse voxel grids that uses Hierarchical DDA to bulk-skip empty regions and optionally performs density-based skipping within occupied areas.
